title: Lemon Drop Freebase E-Liquid – Peach 100ml
description:
Description
Introducing Peach by Lemon Drop, a mouth-watering flavour that will tantalize your taste buds with every puff. This premium e-juice is made with high-quality ingredients, ensuring a smooth and satisfying vaping experience. The delightful blend of ripe, juicy peaches creates a sweet and refreshing flavour that is perfect for any time of day.
Each bottle of Peach by Lemon Drop contains 100ml of e-liquid, providing you with hours of vaping pleasure. The 70/30 VG/PG blend creates a smooth and satisfying vaping experience with dense clouds of vapor. This e-liquid is perfect for both beginner and experienced vapers who love fruity flavours.
Peach by Lemon Drop comes in a convenient chubby gorilla bottle with a child-resistant cap for safety. The bottle design makes it easy to fill your tank or pod without any mess or hassle.
Whether you’re looking for a new all-day vape or just a delicious fruity flavour to mix things up, Peach by Lemon Drop is the perfect choice. Try it today and experience the sweet, refreshing taste of ripe, juicy peaches in every puff.
Flavour Notes:
Peach
Lemon
70/30 VG/PG
